Class Skills

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.Skills
public final class Skills extends Object
Skills from MMO Skill Tree (by Ziggfreed), when it runs: one level per skill (Mining, Swords, custom skills), skill XP, and what happens in it, for any plugin, without depending on the mod. Since API_VERSION 19.

What players do there is fired as PlayerActions, with the skill, achievement, quest or character after the colon (the "subject"): 

"mmo_skill_level:MINING Mining"   amount: the new level (once per level-up of that skill)
"mmo_skill_xp:MINING Mining"      amount: XP gained from play (not XP Tempest gave)
"mmo_achievement:dragon_slayer"   amount: 1
"mmo_quest:village_help"          amount: 1 (one of its own quests finished)
"npc_talk:blacksmith Blacksmith"  amount: 1 (a credited conversation; the character's id, then what else it answers to)

PlayerActions.listen((player, action, amount) -> {
    if (action.startsWith(Skills.SKILL_LEVEL)) { String skill = action.substring(Skills.SKILL_LEVEL.length()); ... }
});
Levels are read on join, every half minute and after every XP gain; a player not read yet has none.

      public static boolean giveXp(UUID player, String skill, double amount, String reason)
      Gives skill XP from play-like rewards, with the mod's own XP banner: in this skill (its id or name), or, when it is blank or unknown, in the skill the admin chose for Tempest's leveling XP. False when the mod is not running or the player is not online.
